q1_issues.issue: "left silken threads" takes Patient, but the threads are deposited rather than created/destroyed/physically changed, so the object-change test (and its "when unclear, default to Theme" fallback) gives Theme.

"that night" is an anaphoric temporal NP, so term propagation should copy the antecedent's stated day-level terms (Day 80, Year 1) onto sk_tend_1 alongside the day-part symbol; only the bare `night` is emitted.

q2_gaps: "for the first time" — an nth-occurrence adverbial on an event; Ordinal is specified for an entity's rank on a scale, not for counting occasions of the event itself, so the qualifier has no licensed carrier and is dropped
notes: Heads are all licensed (Beside is the entity-attached surface preposition, So the surface connective); the wick correctly gets no invented PartOf to the lantern. Two defensible-but-arguable choices: PartOf rather than Possession for "the lantern of the Harbor Station", and the bare kind fillers half_shift / mist_light where definite mentions might warrant witnesses.
